bool correctBracketing(String brackets) {
  if (brackets.isEmpty) return true;
  
  final stack = <String>[];
  for (var i = 0; i < brackets.length; i++) {
    var c = brackets[i];
    
    // Check if the current character is an opening bracket
    if (c == '(' || c == '{' || c == '[') {
      stack.add(c);
    } else {
      // If it's a closing bracket, check if there's a matching opening one in the stack
      if (stack.isEmpty) return false;
      
      var lastOpen = stack.removeLast();
      if ((lastOpen == '(' && c != ')') ||
          (lastOpen == '{' && c != '}') ||
          (lastOpen == '[' && c != ']')) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }
  
  return stack.isEmpty;
}

    int minIndex = i;
    
    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
      if (arr[j] < arr[minIndex]) {
        minIndex = j;
      }
    }
    
    if (minIndex != i) {
      int temp = arr[i];
      arr[i] = arr[minIndex];
      arr[minIndex] = temp;
    }
  }

List<int> maximum(List<int> arr, int k) {
  if (k == 0 || arr.isEmpty) return [];
  
  List<int> result = [];
  for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - k + 1; i++) {
    int maxVal = arr[i];
    int index = i;
    
    for (int j = i + 1; j <= i + k && j < arr.length; j++) {
      if (arr[j] > maxVal) {
        maxVal = arr[j];
        index = j;
      }
    }
    
    result.add(maxVal);
  }
  
  return result;
}

List<int> compare(List<int> game, List<int> guess) {
  int correct = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < game.length && i < guess.length; i++) {
    if (game[i] == guess[i]) {
      correct++;
    }
  }

  int incorrectPosition = 0;
  final Map<int, int> countMap = {};
  for (var num in game) {
    countMap[num] = countMap.containsKey(num) ? countMap[num]! + 1 : 1;
  }

  for (var num in guess) {
    if (!countMap.containsKey(num)) continue;
    if (num != game[guess.indexOf(num)]) {
      incorrectPosition++;
    }
  }

  return [correct, incorrectPosition];
}

List<int> evenOddCount(int num) {
  int even = 0;
  int odd = 0;

  if (num == 0) return [1, 0];

  while (num != 0) {
    final digit = num % 10;
    num ~/= 10;
    
    if (digit % 2 == 0) {
      even++;
    } else {
      odd++;
    }
  }

  return [even, odd];
}

sub rsp, 16
xor rax, rax
xor rdi, rdi

mov dword [rbp-8], 0 ; odd counter

jz .loop_end

jl .is_even

jmp .loop_next

; Prepare result

mov dl, byte [rbp-8] ; odd count
add ax, dx
sal ax, 16
or ax, dx
ret

mov al, 1
mov dl, 0
add ax, dx
sal ax, 16

bool rightAngleTriangle(num a, num b, num c) {
  // Sort the numbers to identify the largest as potential hypotenuse
  var sides = [a, b, c];
  sides.sort((x, y) => x.compareTo(y));
  
  // Check if the sum of squares of the two smaller equals square of the largest
  return (pow(sides[0], 2) + pow(sides[1], 2)) == pow(sides[2], 2);
}
